verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is a workstation GPU, a hardware compute device with no user-facing data interface where AI-generated insights or suggestions could be shown, so this story is a category error for the product. The evidence covers acceleration of data science and AI workloads through RAPIDS, cuML and cuDF. Those are developer building blocks for building such features, not an in-product insights capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
